purpose: Brief128 route inputs for Claude, not the route itself or a coverage approval.
identifierPolicy: Use the exact NESA CMS content-item codenames. NESA code fields are blank; do not label these as published outcome codes.

officialEvidence.mathPolicy: sourceHtml preserves the official mathematical layout; text is a flattened search aid.

recommendations: Keep candidate IDs/order d01-d10, with revised Year12 boundaries. d01 introduces scaled/shifted exponentials; the unscaled derivative is Year11 knowledge.
d06-d08 recall Year11 chain/product/quotient rules and extend them to the new function families, rather than claiming these rules are new Year12 content.
Use applications L06 for d09 and L09 for d10. Preserve L01 as later exponential application material.
Add later focused homes for tan proof, sec/cosec/cot, remaining trig composites and tangent/normal problems. These are mandatory actions omitted by the first-ten draft, not outgoing content.
After d10 teach physical modelling, continuity/differentiability, second derivatives/concavity and further graphing in a coherent route. The first ten are not complete calculus coverage.
